common.sentence: 我们订了一张靠窗的桌子。
common.note: 订 means to reserve; 靠窗 means by the window.

language_specific.usage_note: 一张桌子 counts a table; 张 is also used for some flat objects.

common.sentence: 村子旁边有一条小河。
common.note: 村子 means village; 小河 means small river.

language_specific.usage_note: 一条小河 counts a river as a long geographical feature.

common.sentence: 杯子上有一道很长的裂缝。
common.note: 裂缝 means crack.

language_specific.usage_note: 一道裂缝 counts a crack as a line or mark.

common.sentence: 请把那扇窗户打开。

language_specific.usage_note: 那扇窗户 identifies one window; 扇 also counts doors.

common.sentence: 教室里有一面墙是白色的。
common.note: 墙 means wall.

language_specific.usage_note: 一面墙 counts one wall as a surface.

common.sentence: 她从地上捡起一颗小石头。
common.note: 捡起 means to pick up; 石头 means stone.

language_specific.usage_note: 一颗小石头 counts one small stone, drawing attention to its small, rounded form.

common.sentence: 桌上还有一粒米，擦掉吧。
common.note: 擦掉 means to wipe off.

language_specific.usage_note: 一粒米 counts an individual grain of rice.

common.sentence: 过了这座桥就到车站了。
common.note: 桥 means bridge.

language_specific.usage_note: 这座桥 identifies a bridge; 座 commonly counts substantial fixed structures.

common.sentence: 请给我一份炒饭，带走。
common.note: 炒饭 means fried rice; 带走 means to take away.

language_specific.usage_note: 一份炒饭 orders one serving, without specifying its container.

common.sentence: 这苹果很甜，你咬一口尝尝。
common.note: 咬 means to bite; 尝尝 means to have a taste.

language_specific.usage_note: 咬一口 counts one bite; 口 can also count a sip of liquid.

common.sentence: 汤太淡了，再加一勺盐吧。
common.note: 淡 means not salty enough here.

language_specific.usage_note: 一勺盐 is an amount held by a spoon; the amount depends on the spoon.

common.sentence: 煮汤时放一撮盐就够了。
common.note: 煮汤 means to make soup; 够 means enough.

language_specific.usage_note: 一撮盐 is a small amount picked up with the fingers.

common.sentence: 往锅里放一把米，煮点粥。
common.note: 锅 means pot; 粥 means rice porridge.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target and following syllable: 把米 is normally pronounced bá mǐ, with the first of the two third tones realized as a rising tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 一把米 is roughly the amount of rice held in one hand.

common.sentence: 往杯里加两滴柠檬汁。
common.note: 往杯里 means into the cup; 柠檬汁 means lemon juice.

language_specific.usage_note: In 两滴柠檬汁, 滴 counts individual drops of liquid.

common.sentence: 孩子只吃了半碗饭就饱了。
common.note: 饱 means full after eating.

language_specific.usage_note: 半碗饭 measures approximately half a bowlful of rice.

common.sentence: 花太干了，给它浇一瓢水。
common.note: 浇 means to water; 瓢 is a dipper.

language_specific.usage_note: 一瓢水 is the amount of water held in a dipper.

common.sentence: 坐地铁比开车方便得多。
common.note: 坐地铁 means to take the subway; 开车 means to drive.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 得 is neutral-toned in this complement.
language_specific.usage_note: After 方便 in a 比 comparison, 得多 marks a large difference in convenience.

common.sentence: 这次考试已经很难了，下次还要比这次难。
common.note: 考试 means exam.

language_specific.usage_note: 还 emphasizes that the next exam will exceed an already high degree of difficulty.

common.sentence: 这个箱子比那个稍微轻一点。
common.note: 箱子 means suitcase or box.

language_specific.usage_note: 稍微 precedes 轻 and, with 一点 after it, marks a small difference in weight.

common.sentence: 这家店比那家店安静一些。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is pronounced yì before the first-tone syllable 些.
language_specific.usage_note: After 安静 in a 比 comparison, 一些 marks a modest difference in quietness.

common.sentence: 她的中文说得比我流利。

language_specific.usage_note: After 说得比我, 流利 compares how fluently she and the speaker speak Chinese.

common.sentence: 他写字比我写得认真。

language_specific.usage_note: The repeated verb and 得 introduce a comparison of how carefully the two people write.

common.sentence: 这条路比想象中远，我们坐车吧。
common.note: 想象 means to imagine.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 比 is pronounced bí before the third-tone syllable 想.
language_specific.usage_note: 比想象中 introduces the imagined degree as the baseline; 远 gives the actual comparative quality.

common.sentence: 这个问题比看起来复杂。
common.note: 看起来 means to appear.

language_specific.usage_note: The question is more complex than it appears; 看起来 supplies the apparent baseline.

common.sentence: 你的房间比我的大多少？

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 少 is neutral-toned in 多少.
language_specific.usage_note: 多少 follows 大 to ask for the size of the difference between the rooms.

common.sentence: 这件衣服比那件只贵一块钱。
common.note: 件 is a classifier for garments; 块钱 is a colloquial unit of yuan.

language_specific.usage_note: 只 limits the price difference to one yuan, presenting it as small.

common.sentence: 我想找比这间更安静的房间。
common.note: 这间 refers to the room being compared.

language_specific.usage_note: 比 introduces the baseline inside 比这间更安静的, which modifies 房间.

common.sentence: 比起坐车，我更愿意走路。
common.note: 愿意 means willing; 走路 means to walk.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 比 is normally pronounced bí before the third tone of 起.
language_specific.usage_note: 比起 introduces taking a vehicle as the alternative to the speaker's greater willingness to walk.

common.sentence: 这杯咖啡的价格比那杯高一倍。
common.meaning: fold; a multiple of a reference amount
common.note: 价格 means price.

language_specific.usage_note: After 比那杯高, 一倍 states that the increase equals the other coffee's price, so this coffee costs twice as much.

common.sentence: 这个办法比以前的有效。
common.note: 办法 means method; 以前的 refers to the previous method.

language_specific.usage_note: 比以前的有效 compares the effectiveness of this method with the previous one.

common.sentence: 我这周工作比上周忙。

language_specific.usage_note: 忙 compares how busy the speaker is with work this week and last week.

common.sentence: 这次旅行比上次有意思。
common.note: 旅行 means trip; 上次 refers to the previous trip.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 思 is neutral-toned in 意思.
language_specific.usage_note: 有意思 is the quality compared: this trip is more interesting than the previous one.

common.sentence: 今天没有昨天那么热。

language_specific.usage_note: A 没有 B 那么热 says A is less hot than B; 没有 compares degree here rather than expressing absence.

common.sentence: 我做饭没有妈妈做得快。

language_specific.usage_note: 没有 introduces the person whose cooking speed is the baseline; 做得快 specifies the dimension.

common.sentence: 这道题没有我想的那么难。
common.note: 这道题 means this question or problem.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 么 is neutral-toned.
language_specific.usage_note: In 没有我想的那么难, 那么 points to the degree of difficulty the speaker expected.

common.sentence: 这双鞋没有那双舒服。

language_specific.usage_note: 没有 compares comfort directly: this pair is less comfortable than that pair.

common.sentence: 这家店的茶不如那家新鲜。
common.note: 那家 refers to the other shop.

language_specific.usage_note: 不如 compares the freshness of the tea from the two shops and places the first below the second.

common.sentence: 他听中文不如读中文容易。

language_specific.usage_note: 不如 compares two activities for him: listening to Chinese is less easy than reading it.

common.sentence: 走路太慢了，不如坐地铁吧。

language_specific.usage_note: 不如 introduces the suggested action 坐地铁 as a better option than walking, which the preceding clause presents as too slow.

common.sentence: 这次会议不如上次长。
common.note: 会议 means meeting; 上次 refers to the previous meeting.

language_specific.usage_note: 不如上次长 says this meeting is shorter than the previous one.

common.sentence: 我跟姐姐买了一样的书。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is pronounced yí before the fourth-tone syllable 样; 的 is neutral-toned.
language_specific.usage_note: 一样的 modifies 书 and says that the speaker and sister bought the same kind of book.

common.sentence: 你的包跟我的一样重吗？

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is pronounced yí before the fourth-tone syllable 样.
language_specific.usage_note: 跟我的一样重 asks about equal weight when the sentence ends in 吗.

common.sentence: 这两条路不一样远。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 is pronounced bù before 一, and 一 is pronounced yí before 样.
language_specific.usage_note: 不一样远 denies equal distance; it does not say which route is farther.

common.sentence: 上午已经很冷，晚上更冷。

language_specific.usage_note: 更冷 compares the evening with the already cold morning stated in the first clause.

common.sentence: 这两条路，哪条更近？

language_specific.usage_note: 更近 asks which of the two stated routes is nearer.

common.sentence: 这三本书里，这本最不实用。
common.note: 实用 means practical or useful.

language_specific.usage_note: 最不 before 实用 identifies the lowest degree of usefulness within the three-book set.

common.sentence: 这三个时间，哪个最方便？

language_specific.usage_note: 最方便 asks which of the three stated times is most convenient.

common.sentence: 小李很高，但在三个人里并不是最高的。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 is pronounced bú before the fourth-tone syllable 是.
language_specific.usage_note: 并不是 emphatically denies the superlative claim: Xiao Li is tall but is not the tallest of the three.

common.sentence: 这张桌子比那张高整整五厘米。
common.note: 厘米 means centimeter.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: the first 整 is pronounced zhéng before the following third-tone syllable.
language_specific.usage_note: 整整 emphasizes the full five-centimeter difference after 高.

common.sentence: 这条裤子比那条短不到三厘米。
common.note: 裤子 means trousers; 厘米 means centimeter.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 is pronounced bú before the fourth-tone syllable 到.
language_specific.usage_note: 不到 limits the difference after 短 to less than three centimeters.

common.sentence: 这本词典比那本贵十块钱左右。
common.note: 词典 means dictionary; 块钱 is a colloquial unit of yuan.

language_specific.usage_note: 左右 follows the quantity and makes the ten-yuan price difference approximate.

common.sentence: 今天我比昨天早到将近十分钟。

language_specific.usage_note: 将近 modifies the difference after 早到: the arrival times are nearly ten minutes apart.

common.sentence: 我比姐姐正好小四岁。
common.note: 姐姐 means older sister.

language_specific.usage_note: 正好 specifies that the age difference expressed by 小四岁 is exactly four years.
language_specific.pronunciation_note: In 正好小, 好 is pronounced with a second tone before the third tone of 小: zhèngháo xiǎo.

common.sentence: 今天的课比昨天少了足足两节。
common.note: 节 is a classifier for class periods.

language_specific.usage_note: 足足 emphasizes the full difference of two class periods after 少了.

common.sentence: 这杯茶比那杯多了至少两勺糖。
common.note: 勺 is a measure word for spoonfuls.

language_specific.usage_note: 至少 sets two spoonfuls as the minimum difference in sugar, not the minimum total in the cup.

common.sentence: 坐公交比坐地铁多花至多二十分钟。
common.note: 公交 means public bus; 花 here means to spend time.

language_specific.usage_note: 至多 sets twenty minutes as the maximum extra time spent on the bus compared with the subway.

common.sentence: 刚才敲门的人是快递员。
common.meaning: links a clause to its agent noun
common.note: 快递员 means delivery worker.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 刚才敲门 modifies 人; that person performed the action of knocking.

common.sentence: 坐在窗边的老师教我们中文。
common.meaning: links a state clause to its agent noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 坐在窗边 identifies 老师 as the person sitting by the window.

common.sentence: 给我送花的人已经走了。
common.meaning: links a giving clause to its agent noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 人 is the giver in 给我送花; 我 is the recipient.

common.sentence: 来修空调的师傅到了。
common.meaning: links a purpose clause to its agent noun
common.note: 师傅 is a respectful form of reference to a skilled worker; 空调 means air conditioner.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 师傅 is the person who came to repair the air conditioner; 修空调 states the purpose of 来.

common.sentence: 跑进教室的学生忘了带书。
common.meaning: links a directional action to its agent noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 学生 is the person who ran into the classroom; 进 expresses the direction into it.

common.sentence: 做完作业的孩子可以出去玩。
common.meaning: links a completed action to its agent noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 孩子 is the one who has finished the homework; 完 marks completion within the modifier.

common.sentence: 去过成都的人请举手。
common.meaning: links an experience clause to its agent noun
common.note: 举手 means to raise one's hand.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 人 refers to those who have visited Chengdu; 过 marks their experience.

common.sentence: 正在开会的经理不能接电话。
common.meaning: links an ongoing action to its agent noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 经理 is the person currently attending a meeting; 正在 marks that action as in progress.

common.sentence: 没交作业的同学明天补交。
common.meaning: links a negative action clause to its agent noun
common.note: 补交 means to submit something later to make up for a missed submission.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 没交作业 selects 同学 who have not submitted their homework; 没 negates that action.

common.sentence: 会说日语的护士在二楼。
common.meaning: links an ability clause to its agent noun
common.note: 护士 means nurse.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 护士 is the person who can speak Japanese; 会 expresses an ability.

common.sentence: 在厨房帮忙的客人是小李。
common.meaning: links an action and its location to its agent noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 客人 is the person helping, and 在厨房 locates that action.

common.sentence: 负责订票的人今天请假了。
common.meaning: links a responsibility clause to its agent noun
common.note: 负责 means to be responsible for; 请假 means to take leave.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 人 is the person responsible for booking tickets; the modifier describes a responsibility, not necessarily a completed booking.

common.sentence: 我借的书下周要还。
common.meaning: links a borrowing clause to its object noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 书 is the object of 借: the speaker borrowed the book.

common.sentence: 妈妈做的汤还很热。
common.meaning: links a making clause to its object noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 汤 is what 妈妈 made; it is the object of 做 in the modifier.

common.sentence: 老师给我的建议很有用。
common.meaning: links a giving clause to its object noun
common.note: 建议 means advice or a suggestion; 有用 means useful.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 建议 is what 老师 gave; 我 is the recipient.

common.sentence: 我为孩子准备的午饭在桌上。
common.meaning: links a preparation clause to its object noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 午饭 is what the speaker prepared; 为孩子 identifies the intended beneficiary.

common.sentence: 她写完的报告在电脑里。
common.meaning: links a completed action to its object noun
common.note: 报告 means report.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 报告 is what 她 finished writing; 完 marks completion of the writing.

common.sentence: 小王带来的蛋糕很好吃。
common.meaning: links a bringing action to its object noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 蛋糕 is what 小王 brought; 来 indicates movement toward the relevant location.

common.sentence: 你想看的电影今晚八点开始。
common.meaning: links a desired action to its object noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 电影 is the object of 看; 想 says the listener wants to watch it, without saying they have done so.

common.sentence: 我没找到的钥匙在沙发下。
common.meaning: links a negative result clause to its object noun
common.note: 沙发 means sofa.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 钥匙 is what the speaker failed to find; 没找到 negates a successful finding.

common.sentence: 你说的地址是这儿吗？
common.meaning: links a mentioning clause to its object noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 地址 is what the listener mentioned; the question checks whether this is the place they meant.

common.sentence: 大家讨论的问题解决了吗？
common.meaning: links a discussion clause to its object noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 问题 is what 大家 discussed; the main question asks whether that problem has been solved.

common.sentence: 她选的座位靠近门口。
common.meaning: links a choosing clause to its object noun
common.note: 座位 means seat; 靠近 means close to.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 座位 is the seat 她 chose; it is the object of 选.

common.sentence: 我贴在门上的通知不见了。
common.meaning: links a placement action to its object noun
common.note: 通知 means notice; 不见了 means it is missing.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 通知 is what the speaker posted; 在门上 gives the resulting location of the notice.

common.sentence: 我到家的时候，天已经黑了。
common.meaning: links an event to its time

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 我到家的时候 sets the time at which it was already dark.

common.sentence: 吃饭的时候请别看手机。
common.meaning: links an activity to its time

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 吃饭的时候 specifies the period during which the listener is asked not to look at a phone.

common.sentence: 开会的时间改到下午三点了。
common.meaning: links an event to its scheduled time

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 开会的时间 refers to the meeting time; 改到 gives its new scheduled time.

common.sentence: 你离开的那天我正好休息。
common.meaning: links an event to a specific day
common.note: 正好 means as it happened or by coincidence.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 你离开的那天 identifies the day on which the listener left; it sets the time for 我休息.

common.sentence: 我们见面的地方就在车站旁边。
common.meaning: links an event to its location

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 我们见面的地方 identifies the place where we meet; 就在 locates it beside the station.

common.sentence: 你停车的地方不能停车。
common.meaning: links a parking action to its location

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 你停车的地方 identifies where the listener parked; the main clause says parking is prohibited there.

common.sentence: 她工作的城市冬天常下雪。
common.meaning: links an activity to its city

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 她工作的城市 is the city where she works; the main clause describes its winter weather.

common.sentence: 我们住的房间没有窗户。
common.meaning: links a residence situation to its room

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 房间 is the place where 我们住; the main clause describes that room.

common.sentence: 请给我没用过的杯子，这个用过了。
common.meaning: not used before, modifying a noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 过 and 的 are pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 没用过的 selects a cup that has not been used before; 过 concerns prior experience, and 的 links the restriction to 杯子.

common.sentence: 请用中文的表格，别用英文表格。
common.meaning: links a language specification to a noun
common.note: 表格 means form.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 中文的表格 specifies a form in Chinese; the second clause rules out an English form.

common.sentence: 我要靠窗的座位，不要靠门口的。
common.meaning: by the window, modifying a noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 靠窗的 modifies 座位 and selects a seat by the window; 靠门口的 omits the understood noun 座位.

common.sentence: 请给我大一点的碗，这个太小。
common.meaning: a little bigger, modifying a noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is yī in citation form and is pronounced yì before the third-tone 点; 的 is neutral.
language_specific.usage_note: 大一点的 modifies 碗 and asks for a somewhat larger bowl than the one described as too small.

common.sentence: 我要明天能送到的书，后天太晚。
common.meaning: able to be delivered, modifying a noun
common.note: 后天 means the day after tomorrow.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 明天能送到的 restricts 书 to books that can arrive by delivery tomorrow. 能 expresses possibility, 到 marks arrival, and 的 links the clause to 书.

common.sentence: 这几双鞋里，我还没找到适合的尺码。
common.note: 尺码 means size, as for clothing or shoes.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 适合的 restricts 尺码 to a size that fits the speaker.

common.sentence: 请给我不加糖的咖啡，我不喝甜咖啡。
common.meaning: without added sugar, modifying a noun

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 retains its fourth tone before first-tone 加; 的 is neutral.
language_specific.usage_note: 不加糖的 modifies 咖啡 and specifies coffee without added sugar; 不喝甜咖啡 explains the choice.

common.sentence: 请给我买了以后可以退的票。
common.meaning: permitted to be returned, modifying a noun
common.note: 买了以后 means after buying.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 可 is pronounced with a rising tone before the third tone of 以; 的 is neutral.
language_specific.usage_note: 买了以后可以退的 restricts 票 to tickets that may be returned after purchase; 的 links the restriction to 票.

common.sentence: 今天早点走吧，因为末班车八点开。
common.note: 末班车 means the last scheduled bus or train.

language_specific.usage_note: 因为 introduces the reason for the preceding suggestion.

common.sentence: 因为路上堵车，所以我迟到了。
common.note: 堵车 means traffic is congested; 迟到 means to arrive late.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 所 is pronounced with a rising tone before the third tone of 以.
language_specific.usage_note: 所以 introduces the result of the cause marked by 因为.

common.sentence: 你怎么没去？因为我发烧了。
common.note: 发烧 means to have a fever.

language_specific.usage_note: 因为 introduces an answer giving the reason for the absence asked about.

common.sentence: 店里没人，可能是因为今天放假。
common.note: 可能 means possibly; 放假 means to have a holiday or time off.

language_specific.usage_note: 是因为 presents the following clause as an explanation; 可能 makes that explanation tentative.

common.sentence: 我是因为喜欢孩子才当老师的。
common.meaning: marks the stated reason for the outcome

language_specific.usage_note: In 是因为……才……的, 才 highlights the stated reason for becoming a teacher.

common.sentence: 我不是因为累才走，是有事。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 is pronounced bú before the fourth tone of 是.
language_specific.usage_note: 不是因为……才 denies tiredness as the reason for leaving; the speaker gives another reason.

common.sentence: 既然你有空，就帮我看看吧。

language_specific.usage_note: 既然 presents the addressee's availability as an accepted basis for the request introduced by 就.

common.sentence: 既然明天休息，我们就晚点出发。
common.note: 出发 means to set off.

language_specific.usage_note: 就 introduces a decision based on the accepted circumstance marked by 既然.

common.sentence: 原来你没吃早饭，难怪这么饿。

language_specific.usage_note: 难怪 presents the hunger as understandable in light of the newly learned reason.

common.sentence: 窗户没关，怪不得屋里这么冷。
common.note: 窗户 means window.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 and 得 are neutral-tone syllables in 怪不得.
language_specific.usage_note: 怪不得 introduces an observed situation that the preceding fact helps explain.

common.sentence: 昨晚下了大雪，因而今天的课停了。

language_specific.usage_note: 因而 introduces the cancellation of class as a consequence of the heavy snow.

common.sentence: 活动之所以延期，是因为场地在维修。
common.note: 延期 means to postpone; 场地 means venue; 维修 means to repair.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 所 is pronounced with a rising tone before the third tone of 以.
language_specific.usage_note: 之所以 introduces the outcome whose reason is given after 是因为.

common.sentence: 由于大雪，今天的航班取消了。
common.note: 航班 means flight; 取消 means to cancel.

language_specific.usage_note: 由于 introduces the cause of the cancellation; it is common in written notices.

common.sentence: 会议室在修，因此今天换个地方。
common.note: 会议室 means meeting room; 换个地方 means to use another place.

language_specific.usage_note: 因此 introduces the resulting change of place; it is more common in writing than casual speech.

common.sentence: 雨下得太大，结果比赛停了。
common.note: 比赛 means match or competition.

language_specific.usage_note: 结果 introduces the outcome of the heavy rain, often highlighting an outcome worth reporting.

common.sentence: 他输错了密码，导致账号锁住了。
common.note: 输错 means to enter incorrectly; 账号 means account; 锁住 means to lock.

language_specific.usage_note: 导致 links the mistaken entry to an undesirable consequence.

common.sentence: 水管坏了，造成楼下漏水。
common.note: 水管 means water pipe; 漏水 means water leaks.

language_specific.usage_note: 造成 introduces the harmful result brought about by the broken pipe.

common.sentence: 多亏你提醒，我才没忘带票。
common.note: 提醒 means to remind.

language_specific.usage_note: 多亏 credits the reminder for the favorable outcome; 才 emphasizes its importance.

common.sentence: 都怪我看错时间，大家等久了。
common.meaning: it is all the fault of
common.note: 看错时间 means to misread the time.

language_specific.usage_note: 都怪 assigns blame for the long wait to the speaker's mistake.

common.sentence: 因为下雨，野餐只好改到室内。
common.meaning: to have no choice but to
common.note: 野餐 means picnic; 室内 means indoors.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 只 is pronounced with a rising tone before the third tone of 好.
language_specific.usage_note: 只好 presents moving the picnic indoors as a reluctant response to the rain.

common.sentence: 如果明天下雨，我们就在家吃饭。

language_specific.usage_note: 如果 introduces a possible condition; 就 introduces the planned response.

common.sentence: 要是你找不到路，就给我打电话。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 是 is a neutral-tone syllable in the colloquial conjunction 要是.
language_specific.usage_note: 要是 introduces a possible difficulty and 就 introduces what to do in that case.

common.sentence: 如果你现在出门，就能赶上车。
common.note: 赶上车 means to catch the bus or train in time.

language_specific.usage_note: 就 introduces the expected consequence of the condition marked by 如果.

common.sentence: 只要带上票，就可以进场。
common.note: 进场 means to enter the venue.

language_specific.usage_note: 只要 presents bringing the ticket as sufficient for entry; 就 introduces the consequence.

common.sentence: 只要提前说，我们就能等你。
common.note: 提前说 means to say so in advance.

language_specific.usage_note: 就 introduces what can happen if the sufficient condition marked by 只要 is met.

common.sentence: 只有输入密码，才能打开文件。
common.note: 输入密码 means to enter a password; 文件 means file.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 只 is pronounced with a rising tone before the third tone of 有.
language_specific.usage_note: 只有 marks entering the password as necessary for opening the file; 才 introduces the restricted outcome.

common.sentence: 只有大人陪着，孩子才能进泳池。
common.note: 陪着 means accompanying; 泳池 means swimming pool.

language_specific.usage_note: 才 marks adult accompaniment, introduced by 只有, as necessary for the child's entry.

common.sentence: 除非下大雨，否则我们照常出发。
common.note: 照常 means as usual; 出发 means to set off.

language_specific.usage_note: 除非 introduces heavy rain as an exception to the plan stated after 否则.

common.sentence: 请先保存文件，否则改动会丢失。
common.note: 保存 means to save; 改动 means changes; 丢失 means to be lost.

language_specific.usage_note: 否则 introduces the consequence if the requested saving is not done first.

common.sentence: 不带钥匙的话，你就进不了门。
common.note: 进不了门 means to be unable to get in.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 is pronounced in the neutral tone.
language_specific.usage_note: 的话 follows the condition; 就 introduces the consequence of not bringing the key.

common.sentence: 你有空的话，就来帮我搬桌子。
common.note: 搬 means to move or carry.

language_specific.usage_note: 就 introduces a request that applies if the condition marked by 的话 is met.

common.sentence: 万一火车晚点，我们就打车去。
common.note: 晚点 means to run late; 打车 means to take a taxi.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 retains its first tone in the lexicalized conjunction 万一.
language_specific.usage_note: 万一 introduces an undesirable possibility for which the speaker gives a fallback plan.

common.sentence: 有问题就问老师，别自己猜。
common.note: 猜 means to guess.

language_specific.usage_note: 就 links an unmarked condition, having a question, to the instruction to ask the teacher.

common.sentence: 有牛奶就用牛奶，不然就用水。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 is pronounced bù before the second-tone syllable 然.
language_specific.usage_note: 不然 introduces the fallback of using water if milk is unavailable.

common.sentence: 不管你去不去，我都会去。

language_specific.usage_note: 不管 introduces the alternatives in 去不去; 都 marks the speaker's going as true either way.
language_specific.pronunciation_note: In 不管你, 管 is commonly pronounced guán before the third-tone syllable 你; the target’s lexical reading is bùguǎn.

common.sentence: 除非你同意，我才把照片发出去。
common.note: 同意 means to agree; 发出去 means to send out.

language_specific.usage_note: With 除非, 才 makes the addressee's agreement necessary before the speaker sends the photos.

common.sentence: 如果不提前订票，我们就可能没座位。
common.note: 提前订票 means to book tickets in advance; 座位 means seat.

language_specific.usage_note: 如果不 introduces the negative condition of not booking ahead; 就 introduces the possible consequence.

common.sentence: 一旦座位满了，我们就等下一班。
common.note: 座位 means seats; 下一班 means the next scheduled service.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is pronounced yí before the fourth-tone syllable 旦.
language_specific.usage_note: 一旦 presents the seats becoming full as a possible event that triggers waiting for the next service.

common.sentence: 哪怕只剩一分钟，我们也要再检查一次。
common.note: 剩 means to remain; 检查 means to check.

language_specific.usage_note: 哪怕 introduces an extreme condition; 也 marks the intention to check even under that condition.

common.sentence: 除非有人接班，否则她不能离开。
common.note: 接班 means to take over someone's shift.

language_specific.usage_note: 否则 introduces what applies if the exception marked by 除非 does not occur: she cannot leave without someone taking over.

common.sentence: 请把门关上，再开空调。
common.note: 空调 means air conditioner.

language_specific.usage_note: 再 places switching on the air conditioner after closing the door.

common.sentence: 我吃饭前先给妈妈打了电话。

language_specific.usage_note: 前 follows 吃饭 and places the phone call before the meal.

common.sentence: 下课以后，我们一起去图书馆。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 以 is often pronounced with a partial third tone before 后.
language_specific.usage_note: 以后 follows 下课 and places the trip after class ends.

common.sentence: 先加水，然后把锅放在火上。
common.note: 锅 means pot.

language_specific.usage_note: 然后 introduces the next step after the water is added.

common.sentence: 先检查名字，最后在这里签字。
common.note: 签字 means to sign one's name.

language_specific.usage_note: 最后 presents signing as the final step, after checking the name.

common.sentence: 我一到家就给你发消息。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 一 is pronounced yí before the fourth-tone syllable 到.
language_specific.usage_note: In 一……就……, 一 marks arriving home as the event immediately preceding the message.

common.sentence: 水一开就把面放进去。

language_specific.usage_note: In 一……就……, 就 marks putting in the noodles immediately after the water boils.

common.sentence: 等雨停了，我们再出门。

language_specific.usage_note: 等 introduces the event to wait for; 再 places leaving after the rain stops.

common.sentence: 等到灯变绿，你再过马路。
common.note: 过马路 means to cross the road.

language_specific.usage_note: 等到 marks the point reached before the listener should cross.

common.sentence: 他一直工作到天黑才回家。
common.note: 天黑 means nightfall.

language_specific.usage_note: 到 marks nightfall as the endpoint of the continuing work; 才 places his return after it.

common.sentence: 她直到十点才做完作业。

language_specific.usage_note: 直到 marks the late time reached before the completion expressed with 才.

common.sentence: 他等了半小时，车才来。

language_specific.usage_note: 才 presents the bus's arrival as late, after a half-hour wait.

common.sentence: 她做饭，同时听音乐。

language_specific.usage_note: 同时 introduces an activity that happens at the same time as the preceding one.

common.sentence: 我洗碗的时候，他在擦桌子。
common.note: 擦桌子 means to wipe the table.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 的 and 候 are neutral-tone syllables here.
language_specific.usage_note: 的时候 follows the dishwashing clause and sets the time during which he is wiping the table.

common.sentence: 开会之前，请大家关掉手机。

language_specific.usage_note: 之前 follows 开会 and places switching off phones before the meeting.

common.sentence: 收到邮件之后，请给我回个电话。
common.note: 收到 means to receive.

language_specific.usage_note: 之后 follows receipt of the email and places the return call later.

common.sentence: 休息十分钟，接着讨论这个问题。
common.note: 讨论 means to discuss.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 着 is neutral in 接着.
language_specific.usage_note: 接着 introduces the next activity after the break.

common.sentence: 他先问了一个问题，又问了一个。

language_specific.usage_note: 又 marks a further question by the same person after his first question.

common.sentence: 喝完水，她继续看书。

language_specific.usage_note: 继续 presents her reading as continuing after she drinks water.

common.sentence: 会议结束了，大家随后离开了会场。
common.note: 会场 means the place where the meeting is held.

language_specific.usage_note: 随后 places the departure after the meeting ends.

common.sentence: 房间不大，但是很安静。

language_specific.usage_note: 但是 introduces the room's quietness as a contrasting positive feature.

common.sentence: 我想帮忙，可是今天没有时间。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 可 is often pronounced with a partial third tone before 是.
language_specific.usage_note: 可是 introduces the lack of time that stands in the way of helping.

common.sentence: 虽然路有点远，我们还是走过去吧。

language_specific.usage_note: 虽然 introduces the distance as a difficulty; 还是 presents walking as the choice despite it.

common.sentence: 虽然下着雨，她还是去了。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 是 is neutral in this reading of 还是.
language_specific.usage_note: 还是 marks her going as occurring despite the rain introduced by 虽然.

common.sentence: 他答应了帮忙，却一直没来。

language_specific.usage_note: 却 marks his failure to come as contrary to the expectation created by his promise.

common.sentence: 我劝他休息，他反而工作得更晚。
common.note: 劝 means to advise or urge.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 反 is often pronounced with a partial third tone before 而.
language_specific.usage_note: 反而 presents working later as the opposite of the expected response to the advice.

common.sentence: 我以为他会生气，他倒笑了。
common.note: 生气 means to get angry.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 倒 is pronounced dào as a contrastive adverb; the verb meaning to fall is dǎo.
language_specific.usage_note: 倒 presents his smile as contrary to the speaker's expectation that he would get angry.

common.sentence: 我不是忘了，而是不知道时间。

language_specific.usage_note: 而是 introduces the correct explanation after 不是 rejects forgetting.

common.sentence: 这家店便宜，不过离家有点远。

language_specific.usage_note: 不过 introduces a qualification to the favorable point that the shop is inexpensive.
language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 is pronounced bú before the fourth-tone syllable 过.

common.sentence: 她看起来很年轻，其实已经四十岁了。

language_specific.usage_note: 其实 introduces her actual age in contrast with the impression given by her appearance.

common.sentence: 我本来想坐车，后来决定走路。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 本 is often pronounced with a partial third tone before 来.
language_specific.usage_note: 本来 marks the original intention, which contrasts with the later decision.

common.sentence: 我以为店关门了，没想到还开着。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 想 is often pronounced with a partial third tone before 到.
language_specific.usage_note: 没想到 introduces the unexpected fact that the shop is still open, contrary to the speaker's belief.

common.sentence: 这个包好看，就是有点贵。

language_specific.usage_note: 就是 introduces a reservation about the otherwise favorable assessment.

common.sentence: 这道题不难，只是需要时间。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 只 is often pronounced with a partial third tone before 是.
language_specific.usage_note: 只是 qualifies the claim that the problem is not difficult by noting that it takes time.

common.sentence: 哥哥喜欢热闹，妹妹则喜欢安静。
common.note: 热闹 describes a lively atmosphere.

language_specific.usage_note: 则 marks the younger sister's preference as contrasted with her older brother's.

common.sentence: 他很认真，然而结果并不理想。
common.note: 理想 here means satisfactory.

language_specific.usage_note: 然而 introduces the disappointing result in contrast with his serious effort.

common.sentence: 尽管天气冷，孩子们还是想出去玩。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 尽 is pronounced jín before the third-tone syllable 管.
language_specific.usage_note: 尽管 introduces the cold weather as a concession; 还是 marks the children's wish as holding despite it.

common.sentence: 与其在家等，不如去问问。
common.note: 与其 introduces the less preferred option.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 retains its fourth tone before the second-tone syllable 如.
language_specific.usage_note: In 与其……不如……, 不如 introduces the option preferred over waiting at home.

common.sentence: 这次没坐车，而是走回家的。

language_specific.usage_note: 而是 introduces the actual means of returning home after the alternative is denied with 没.

common.sentence: 他嘴上说不困，实际上已经困了。
common.note: 嘴上说 means to say something aloud, without necessarily reflecting one's true state.

language_specific.usage_note: 实际上 introduces his actual sleepy state in contrast with what he says.

common.sentence: 请把作业写完再玩。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the specific homework; 写完 states that the writing must be completed.

common.sentence: 妈妈把汤喝完了。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the soup affected by drinking; 喝完 indicates that none remains.

common.sentence: 出门前，我把饭做好了。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the meal being prepared; 做好 presents it as ready.

common.sentence: 睡觉前把窗户关好。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the window; 关好 asks for it to be properly closed.

common.sentence: 风太大了，把门关紧。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action
common.note: 关紧 means to close tightly.

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the door affected by closing; 紧 specifies the resulting tight closure.

common.sentence: 她把名字写错了。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the name that was written; 写错 indicates that it was written incorrectly.

common.sentence: 我把问题听懂了。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the question heard; 听懂 states that listening led to understanding.

common.sentence: 请把电话记下来。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action
common.note: 电话 here means phone number; 记下来 means to write down.

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the phone number; 记下来 asks for it to be recorded for later use.

common.sentence: 他把杯子洗干净了。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the cup affected by washing; 干净 describes its resulting clean state.

common.sentence: 雨把我的鞋弄湿了。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action
common.note: 弄湿 means to make wet.

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the shoes affected by the rain; 湿 describes their resulting state.
language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target and following syllable: 把我 is normally pronounced bá wǒ, with 把 realized with a rising tone before 我.

common.sentence: 小心，别把杯子打破了。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action
common.note: 打破 means to break.

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the cup at risk; 打破 names the unwanted result, and 别 prohibits bringing it about.

common.sentence: 请把声音调小一点。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action
common.note: 调小 means to turn down.

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the sound level being adjusted; 小一点 specifies the desired reduction.

common.sentence: 她把长发剪短了。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action
common.note: 剪短 means to cut short.

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the long hair affected by cutting; 短 gives the resulting length.

common.sentence: 请把牛奶加热。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action
common.note: 加热 means to heat.

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the milk; 加热 expresses the change to a hotter state.

common.sentence: 他把钱还给朋友了。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the money being returned; 给 marks the friend as its recipient.

common.sentence: 请把照片发给我。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the photos to be sent; 给 identifies their recipient.

common.sentence: 她把孩子送到学校。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the child being taken somewhere; 到学校 gives the destination reached.

common.sentence: 请把包拿进房间。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the bag being moved; 进房间 specifies movement into the room.

common.sentence: 他把猫抱出房间。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action
common.note: 抱 means to carry in one's arms.

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the cat being carried; 出房间 specifies movement out of the room.

common.sentence: 请把灯打开。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the light; 打开 asks for it to be switched on.

common.sentence: 她把头发扎起来了。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action
common.note: 扎起来 means to tie up.

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the hair affected; 扎起来 describes tying it up into a gathered state.

common.sentence: 请把这个字读三遍。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action
common.note: 遍 counts complete repetitions of an action.

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the character to be read; 三遍 bounds the action by the number of readings.

common.sentence: 请把这件事说清楚。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action
common.note: 这件事 means this matter; 说清楚 means to explain clearly.

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the matter to be explained; 说清楚 states that speaking should make it clear.

common.sentence: 请把衣服收起来。
common.meaning: marks an affected object before an action
common.note: 收起来 means to put away.

language_specific.usage_note: 把 introduces the clothes to be put away; 收起来 specifies the resulting stored state.

common.sentence: 请把花放在窗边。

language_specific.usage_note: After 放, 在 introduces the place where the flowers are to end up; 把 marks the flowers as the object moved.

common.sentence: 她把地图挂在墙上。
common.note: 挂 means to hang.

language_specific.usage_note: After 挂, 在 introduces the wall as the map's resulting location.

common.sentence: 请把日期写在纸上。
common.meaning: on, marking where a result appears

language_specific.usage_note: After 写, 在 introduces the surface on which the date is to appear.

common.sentence: 请把盐加到汤里。

language_specific.usage_note: 到 follows 加 and introduces the soup as the destination reached by the salt.

common.sentence: 他把椅子搬到阳台上。
common.note: 阳台 means balcony.

language_specific.usage_note: 到 follows 搬 and introduces the balcony as the chair's destination.

common.sentence: 请把苹果切成小块。
common.note: 切 means to cut; 小块 means small pieces.

language_specific.usage_note: 成 follows 切 and introduces the pieces resulting from cutting the apple.

common.sentence: 她把桌子擦干净了。
common.meaning: clean, as a result of an action
common.note: 擦 means to wipe.

language_specific.usage_note: 干净 follows 擦 and describes the resulting state of the table introduced by 把.

common.sentence: 把饭做好，我们就出门。
common.meaning: ready, as a result of an action

language_specific.usage_note: 好 follows 做 and expresses the intended ready state of the meal; the sentence describes a future sequence without requiring 了.

common.sentence: 我不把工作带回家。

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 remains bù before third-tone 把 in this sentence.
language_specific.usage_note: 不 precedes 把 and negates the practice of taking work home.

common.sentence: 我没把信寄出去。
common.meaning: did not; negates the occurrence of an action
common.note: 寄出去 means to send out by mail.

language_specific.usage_note: 没 precedes 把 and states that sending the letter out did not happen.

common.sentence: 别把热水倒在桌上。
common.note: 倒 means to pour.

language_specific.usage_note: 别 precedes 把 and tells the listener not to pour the hot water onto the table.

common.sentence: 老师说可以把词典带进去。
common.note: 词典 means dictionary.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: in connected speech, 可 is commonly pronounced ké before the third-tone syllable 以.
language_specific.usage_note: 可以 precedes 把 and expresses the teacher's permission to take the dictionary inside.

common.sentence: 箱子太重，我不能把它搬上楼。

language_specific.usage_note: 不能 precedes 把 and expresses inability to carry the heavy box upstairs.

common.sentence: 老师说必须把作业交上来。
common.note: 交上来 means to hand in toward the person collecting it.

language_specific.usage_note: 必须 precedes 把 and expresses the teacher's requirement to hand in the homework.

common.sentence: 老师说不能把答案告诉别人。

language_specific.usage_note: 不能 precedes 把 and, in the teacher's instruction, prohibits telling others the answer.

common.sentence: 明天我要把报告交给经理。
common.note: 报告 means report; 经理 means manager.

language_specific.usage_note: 要 precedes 把 and expresses the speaker's intention to hand the report to the manager.

common.sentence: 服务员给我们两杯热水。
common.note: 服务员 means service worker; 热水 means hot water.

language_specific.usage_note: 给 takes the recipient 我们 followed by the thing given, 两杯热水.

common.sentence: 出门前，妈妈递给我一把伞。
common.note: 出门 means to leave home; 伞 means umbrella.

language_specific.usage_note: 递给 takes the recipient 我 followed by the item handed over, 一把伞.

common.sentence: 毕业时，老师送我一本词典。
common.note: 毕业 means to graduate; 词典 means dictionary.

language_specific.usage_note: 送 takes the recipient 我 followed by the gift, 一本词典.

common.sentence: 我发给姐姐一张照片。
common.note: 照片 means photograph.

language_specific.usage_note: 发给 takes the recipient 姐姐 followed by the photograph sent.

common.sentence: 雨太大了，你能借我一把伞吗？
common.note: 伞 means umbrella.

language_specific.usage_note: 借 takes the borrower 我 followed by the item lent, 一把伞; 你 is the prospective lender.

common.sentence: 我明天还你借给我的钱。
common.note: 借给我的钱 means the money you lent me.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 还 is pronounced huán in the sense of returning or paying back.
language_specific.usage_note: 还 takes 你 as the recipient of repayment and 借给我的钱 as the money that 你 lent to 我.

common.sentence: 下课后，她教我怎么用这个软件。
common.note: 下课后 means after class; 软件 means software.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 教 is pronounced jiāo as a verb meaning to teach.
language_specific.usage_note: 教 takes the learner 我 followed by a clause describing the skill taught.

common.sentence: 请告诉我会议几点开始。
common.note: 会议 means meeting; 几点 asks what time.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 诉 is neutral-toned in 告诉.
language_specific.usage_note: 告诉 takes the person informed, 我, followed by the information requested.

common.sentence: 我问工作人员几点关门。
common.note: 工作人员 means staff member; 几点 asks what time; 关门 means to close.

language_specific.usage_note: 问 takes the person asked, 工作人员, followed by the information question 几点关门.

common.sentence: 妈妈答应我周日带我去公园。
common.note: 周日 means Sunday; 公园 means park.

language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 应 is neutral-toned in 答应.
language_specific.usage_note: 答应 takes the person receiving the promise, 我, followed by the promised action 周日带我去公园.

common.sentence: 经理交给小王一项新工作。
common.meaning: to assign to; to hand over to
common.note: 经理 means manager; 项 classifies tasks.

language_specific.usage_note: 交给 takes 小王 as the person receiving responsibility and 一项新工作 as the assignment.

common.sentence: 房东退了我一百块钱。
common.note: 房东 means landlord; 块 is a colloquial unit of currency.

language_specific.usage_note: 退 takes the recipient 我 followed by the amount refunded.

common.sentence: 饭店收了我们十块服务费。
common.note: 服务费 means service charge; 块 is a colloquial unit of currency.

language_specific.usage_note: 收 takes 我们 as the people charged and 十块服务费 as the amount collected.

common.sentence: 我欠朋友一百块，下周就还。
common.note: 块 is a colloquial unit of currency; 还 means to repay here.

language_specific.usage_note: 欠 takes the person owed, 朋友, followed by the amount owed.

common.sentence: 她卖给邻居一辆自行车。
common.note: 邻居 means neighbor; 辆 classifies vehicles; 自行车 means bicycle.

language_specific.usage_note: 卖给 takes the buyer 邻居 as its first object and the item sold, 一辆自行车, as its second object.

common.sentence: 学校奖励了她一台电脑。
common.note: 台 classifies machines such as computers; 电脑 means computer.

language_specific.usage_note: 奖励 takes the recipient 她 followed by the concrete reward, 一台电脑.

common.sentence: 孩子写完作业，妈妈才让他出去玩。
common.note: 作业 means homework; 才 marks that permission comes only after it is finished.

language_specific.usage_note: 他 is the person allowed to perform 出去玩.

common.sentence: 雨太大，妈妈不让我骑车。
common.note: 骑车 means to ride a bicycle.

language_specific.usage_note: 不 negates the permission: 我 is not allowed to ride.
language_specific.pronunciation_note: Target: 不 is realized as bú before fourth-tone 让; citation Pinyin remains bù.

common.sentence: 医生让我别吃太多盐。
common.note: 盐 means salt; 别 marks a negative instruction.

language_specific.usage_note: 我 is the person instructed; 别 negates the eating instruction, not the act of instructing.

common.sentence: 这条消息让大家都笑了。
common.note: 消息 means news or message.

language_specific.usage_note: The news causes 大家 to perform 笑; 大家 is the person group affected and the subject of 笑.

common.sentence: 先让客人坐下，我们再上菜。
common.note: 客人 means guest; 上菜 means to serve the dishes.

language_specific.usage_note: 客人 is the person invited to sit down before the dishes are served.

common.sentence: 我想让你看看这张照片。
common.note: 看看 means to take a look; 照片 means photograph.

language_specific.usage_note: 你 is the intended viewer and the person who would perform 看看.

common.sentence: 这次让我来开车，你休息一下。
common.meaning: let me take on the task of…
common.note: 开车 means to drive; 休息一下 means to rest for a while.

language_specific.usage_note: 我 is the person proposing to perform 开车; 来 marks taking on the action.

common.sentence: 老师让每个人说一句话。
common.note: 每个人 means each person; 句 classifies utterances.

language_specific.usage_note: 每个人 is both the person addressed by the teacher's instruction and the speaker of 一句话.

common.sentence: 门坏了，我请师傅来修。
common.note: 师傅 is a respectful term for a skilled worker; 修 means to repair.

language_specific.usage_note: 师傅 is the person engaged and the one who will come to repair the door.

common.sentence: 我们请邻居周末来家里吃饭。
common.note: 邻居 means neighbor; 周末 means weekend.

language_specific.usage_note: 邻居 is the invitee and the person invited to come and eat.

common.sentence: 我想请你帮我看看这封信。
common.note: 看看 means to take a look; 封 classifies letters.

language_specific.usage_note: 你 is the person asked and the one who would help review the letter.

common.sentence: 主持人请她先介绍自己。
common.note: 主持人 means host or moderator; 介绍自己 means to introduce oneself.

language_specific.usage_note: 她 is the person invited by the moderator and the one who will introduce herself.

common.sentence: 经理叫小李明天早点到公司。
common.note: 经理 means manager; 早点 means a little earlier.

language_specific.usage_note: 小李 is the person instructed and the person expected to arrive early.

common.sentence: 饭好了，去叫爸爸出来吃饭。
common.note: 饭好了 means the meal is ready; 出来 means to come out.

language_specific.usage_note: 爸爸 is the person summoned and the person expected to come out and eat.

common.sentence: 妈妈叫我别忘了带钥匙。
common.note: 别忘了 means do not forget; 钥匙 means key.

language_specific.usage_note: 我 is the person instructed; 别 negates forgetting within the instruction.

common.sentence: 我没叫他来，他自己来了。
common.note: 自己 means oneself.

language_specific.usage_note: 没 negates the act of asking; 他 is the person who came without being asked.

common.sentence: 出发前，我们再确认一下地址。
common.note: 出发 means to set off; 地址 means address.

language_specific.usage_note: 确认一下 asks for a check that the address is correct.

common.sentence: 做菜前，先看清楚每个步骤。
common.note: 看清楚 means to read or see clearly.

language_specific.usage_note: 每个步骤 refers to each individual step in the cooking process.

common.sentence: 这两步的顺序错了，要先加水。
common.note: 步 means step; 加水 means to add water.

language_specific.usage_note: 顺序 concerns which step comes before the other.

common.sentence: 这次活动，谁负责买水？
common.note: 活动 means event or activity.

language_specific.usage_note: 负责 identifies the person assigned responsibility for buying water.

common.sentence: 我说的是周五，你误会了。
common.note: 周五 means Friday.

language_specific.usage_note: 误会了 indicates that the listener understood the speaker's intended day incorrectly.

common.sentence: 请核对一下名字，看看有没有写错。
common.note: 有没有写错 asks whether something was written incorrectly.

language_specific.usage_note: 核对 asks for the written name to be checked for accuracy.

common.sentence: 表格填错了，我重新填一份。
common.note: 表格 means form; 填错 means to fill in incorrectly; 份 classifies copies.

language_specific.usage_note: 重新 marks filling out a new copy from the beginning after an error.

common.sentence: 这个地方我没看懂，能解释一下吗？
common.note: 这个地方 refers to this part of what is being read; 没看懂 means did not understand it on reading.

language_specific.usage_note: 解释一下 requests a brief explanation of the part the speaker did not understand.
